title.narrative: Global Evaluation and Monitoring Framework Agreement (GEMFA) - Lot IV

description.narrative: Monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) (low value lot meaning below £600,000 per assignment). The monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) lot will cover all evaluation assignments, as well as assignments that include both monitoring and evaluation, including the procurement of MEL units which act as a learning partner throughout the lifespan of the programme. The purpose of evaluation in the FCDO is to contribute to improving the impact and value for money of the FCDO’s development spending and support the effective delivery of the FCDO’s Strategic Objectives. The FCDO needs to produce high quality, independent, relevant evaluations that enable development interventions to be responsive to the poorest people and contribute to their wellbeing. Evaluation seeks to generate evidence and knowledge that is policy and programme relevant and informs effective decision making.
